claim_results.claim: We fit a decoherence equation to the Genesis data.
The model found a floor of 93 years.

## THE CURVE When you plot these lifespans against generation number and fit an exponential decay model, you get this: $$L(n) = L\_0 \cdot e^{-n/\tau} + L\_{\text{floor}}$$ L(n) Lifespan at generation *n* — how long people lived L0 Pre-decay baseline — the starting point before the decay e-n/τ Exponential decay — compounding entropy across generations τ Decay timescale — ~3–4 generations for lifespan to drop to ~37% of L0
We didn't tell the model about Psalm 90.
The model went looking for where the curve levels off — where the exponential decay stops eating away at lifespans and a stable floor appears — and it landed at **93 years**.
When a mathematical model, a three-thousand-year-old text, and modern epidemiological data all independently point at the same region of the number line, you are not looking at coincidence.
It is a measurement record — the oldest biological dataset we have — and it fits a specific mathematical model with high precision.
What you're looking at in the lifespan data is not a mythological claim about people who happened to live very long.
The framework has a precise answer for this, and it's the same answer that appeared in the vacuum energy paper and the Father as Source Field paper and the χ equation paper. χ Field
In biological terms: human lifespan cannot decay to zero because the χ vacuum floor prevents total decoherence.
But it cannot decay to zero because the floor holds.
Because common grace maintains the minimum coupling to the Logos that sustains life at all.
The three measurements differ because they're measuring slightly different things at slightly different times — but they're all pointing at the same feature of the curve.
But the lifespan curve shows something beyond individual accumulation.
It shows a baseline dropping across generations.
Not because of moral failure alone, but because the information channel between the human system and the Logos undergoes signal degradation at each generational remove.
because it follows a consistent mechanism
because each If is a fixed fraction of the last The Flood resets some of the accumulated degradation.
Not to zero — Shem at 600 shows it isn't a complete reset.
The floor is where the compounding stops — not because the degradation stops, but because the χ vacuum ground state maintains a minimum If that the generational degradation cannot breach.
It is the minimum Logos-coupling that human biology requires to function.
From the eternal frame, a thousand years is a watch in the night — because the eternal frame is not subject to the arrow that makes a thousand years feel long.
Not seventy because Moses decided seventy was a good number.
Seventy because that's where the curve levels off — the minimum Logos-coupling that common grace maintains, the biological lifespan that the degraded but grace-held human system can sustain.
He always was closer than the model.
